summary: Held the entire window. The short entered favorably and ran to a peak of roughly +32pts, then oscillated in a wide 11-31pt favorable band with several sharp intraminute pullbacks (e.g. to +11.5pts at t=11m) that each recovered before I had to act -- none of those dips showed sustained against-fires or a break below prior swing lows, so I judged the thesis intact each time and never saw a wrong-direction signature. Episode ended still favorable at +17pts. Next time I'd watch for a close below the most recent higher-low structure combined with multiple against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP) stacking together as the actual wrong-direction tell, rather than reacting to single-frame giveback% spikes on small local legs.
